name: Donchian Channel Breakout – USDJPY
description: Classic Turtle-style Donchian channel breakout strategy on USD/JPY daily bars. Long entry when close breaks above the prior bar's 55-day Donchian upper band (highest high); short entry when close breaks below the prior bar's 55-day Donchian lower band (lowest low). ADX(14) > 25 trend filter required for entries. Exit long when close touches/crosses below the prior bar's 20-day lower band; exit short when close touches/crosses above the prior bar's 20-day upper band. Position sizing: 2% equity risk per trade with stop distance of 2x ATR(14). Risk_unit bundles atomic stop loss at the same 2x ATR(14) distance.
source:
# Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy – USDJPY
# Entry: Close breaks above/below prior bar's 55-day Donchian channel + ADX(14) > 25
# Exit:  Close touches prior bar's opposite 20-day Donchian channel
# Sizing: 2% equity risk, stop at 2x ATR(14)

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# --- Donchian Channels ---
# 55-period channel for entry signals
dc55 = donchian_channel(window=55)(h=high, l=low)
dc55_upper = dc55.donchian_upper
dc55_lower = dc55.donchian_lower

# 20-period channel for exit signals
dc20_exit = donchian_channel(window=20)(h=high, l=low)
dc20_exit_upper = dc20_exit.donchian_upper
dc20_exit_lower = dc20_exit.donchian_lower

# --- Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias ---
# Today's close is compared against YESTERDAY's channel levels
dc55_upper_prev = dc55_upper >> 1
dc55_lower_prev = dc55_lower >> 1
dc20_exit_upper_prev = dc20_exit_upper >> 1
dc20_exit_lower_prev = dc20_exit_lower >> 1

# --- ADX Trend Filter ---
adx_val = adx(period=14)(h=high, l=low)
trending = adx_val > 25

# --- Entry Signals ---
# Long entry: close breaks above prior bar's 55-day upper band
long_breakout = close > dc55_upper_prev

# Short entry: close breaks below prior bar's 55-day lower band
short_breakout = close < dc55_lower_prev

# --- Exit Signals ---
# Exit long: close touches/crosses below prior bar's 20-day lower band
exit_long = close <= dc20_exit_lower_prev

# Exit short: close touches/crosses above prior bar's 20-day upper band
exit_short = close >= dc20_exit_upper_prev

# --- Combine entry + exit using hold_until ---
# Hold long state from breakout (with ADX filter) until 20-day exit fires
long_state = hold_until()(enter=long_breakout and trending, exit=exit_long)

# Hold short state from breakout (with ADX filter) until 20-day exit fires
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_breakout and trending, exit=exit_short)

# --- ATR for risk-based sizing ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(h=high, l=low, c=close)
stop_dist = atr_val * 2

# --- Event markers for channel breakout regime ---
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Donchian Breakout",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
        ColumnSpec(title="Direction", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                   card_color_map={Color.Success: ["LONG"], Color.Error: ["SHORT"]}),
        ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, atr_val, where(long_breakout, "LONG", "SHORT"), long_breakout or short_breakout)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# Risk-unit: 2% equity risk, stop at 2x ATR(14) — bundles position sizing + stop loss
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price, rr_ratio=2.0)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)
